storage: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry cupboard, for up to about 2–3 months after opening. In a hot, humid Mumbai monsoon, store in the fridge to slow rancidity and insects.
looksLike: A fine, reddish-brown to dark-brown flour, darker than wheat atta, sold in pouches. It has a mild earthy smell.
howToPick: The flour should be uniformly dark brown, fine and dry, with a clean, slightly nutty smell. Avoid lumps, any musty or sour smell, or insect webbing. Check the packing date on the pouch.
shelfLife: Usually a few months in a sealed pouch (check the printed best-before date); whole-grain flours go stale faster than refined flour.
mergeNotes: Range 70.0–190.0 was wider than 30% of avg 100.0; narrowed to ±15%.
